message.content: {"note_claim": "The UK is pursuing a policy of defensive operations to protect overseas bases/partners while allowing the US to use UK bases for strikes on missile sites.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "we have given permission for US forces to use long standing basing at RAF Fairford and Diego Garcia to support defensive strikes against the ballistic missiles that are targeting the Gulf.", "reason": "The Foreign Secretary's statement describes UK defensive military support and permission for US forces to use UK bases for strikes on ballistic missiles, directly substantiating the note's policy description."}

parsed.note_claim: The UK is pursuing a policy of defensive operations to protect overseas bases/partners while allowing the US to use UK bases for strikes on missile sites.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: we have given permission for US forces to use long standing basing at RAF Fairford and Diego Garcia to support defensive strikes against the ballistic missiles that are targeting the Gulf.
parsed.reason: The Foreign Secretary's statement describes UK defensive military support and permission for US forces to use UK bases for strikes on ballistic missiles, directly substantiating the note's policy description.
